bearingFit.title: Bearing fit & holder strength
bearingFit.tooltip: Bearing hot/shrink fit and holder structural strength under propeller thrust and torque.
bearingFit.conventionTip: Project convention: every stress AVERAGED, SF = strength / averaged stress. Peak is singularity gauge only.

pull.label: Magnetic pull
pull.tooltip: Radial pull of the air-gap field on the rotor, applied as a surface traction on the iron pole tops and magnet faces the gap sees, at every speed including standstill. EM field: the Maxwell stress of the loaded duty's own stored electromagnetic run, radial part only (the torque stays the torque load's); the pole with the largest pull at that instant is applied to every pole. Uniform: an estimate, one outward pressure p = B²/2μ0.
pull.mpaTooltip: Uniform outward pressure on the gap faces, MPa (0.4 MPa ≈ 1.0 T in the gap, 0.7 MPa ≈ 1.33 T). An estimate; prefer the EM field once the duty has been run.
pull.summary: Magnetic pull, {source}: {peak} MPa peak, {mean} MPa mean on the gap faces, {perPole} kN per pole; surface against field check {ratio}.
